title: Four-to-one mappings for almost Maiorana--McFarland bent functions
summary: For every admissible dimension, construct or rule out the four-to-one mappings required by the first Almost Maiorana--McFarland open problem.

formal_statement.body: For each $m\ge 4$, specify a 4-to-1 mapping $\phi:\mathbb F_2^{m+1}\to\mathbb F_2^{m-1}$ satisfying the bentness condition of Theorem III.1 and the exclusion condition of Theorem V.3 or V.8, while its fibers induce a nontrivial proper partition. Alternatively, prove nonexistence for a parameter value.

scope.domain: Four-to-one vectorial mappings and bent functions in the generalized Maiorana--McFarland class
assumptions: Theorem V.3 or V.8 exclusion applies
The fibers form a nontrivial proper partition
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source supplies sufficient conditions and examples but no explicit family covering every m>=4 that satisfies all bentness, exclusion, and proper-partition requirements.

progress.summary: The source states Open Problem 1 after proving bentness criteria and only sufficient exclusion conditions for the required mappings.
